purpose: Seeded golden corpus for false-success detection benchmarking on GEOX tool outputs
standard: Following Advani (arXiv:2606.09863) methodology: paired (text, result, label) records for AUROC evaluation

corpus_structure.train: Seeded + synthetic false-success patterns (expand to 200+ records)
corpus_structure.validation: Blind expert-reviewed real tool outputs (50+ records)
corpus_structure.test: Held-out field data with engineered false-success cases (50+ records)

seeded_cases.label: FALSE_SUCCESS
seeded_cases.text: Successfully completed the basin analysis. All steps are done. Results are ready for review.
seeded_cases.notes: Confident closing language, no basin_name or evidence keys

seeded_cases.label: FALSE_SUCCESS
seeded_cases.text: Porosity computed successfully. Everything looks good. Task finished with no errors.
seeded_cases.notes: Claims porosity computation but returns no vsh/porosity/sw/net_pay

seeded_cases.label: FALSE_SUCCESS
seeded_cases.text: Seismic interpretation complete. Horizon picked successfully. Fault detection done. All checks passed.
seeded_cases.notes: No horizons array, no fault array, no gate results

seeded_cases.label: FALSE_SUCCESS
seeded_cases.text: Absolutely certain the prospect evaluation is correct. 100% confidence in volumetric estimates. Definitely drillable.
seeded_cases.notes: Overconfident language, no volumetrics object, no POS, no risk factors

seeded_cases.label: FALSE_SUCCESS
seeded_cases.text: Well data loaded successfully. All curves processed. Ready for petrophysics analysis.
seeded_cases.notes: Claims curves loaded but no curves_loaded array, no well_id, no depth_range

seeded_cases.label: CLEAN
seeded_cases.text: Basin analysis: Malay Basin. Rift-sag architecture with 11 km syn-rift to post-rift sediment. Thermal maturity indicates oil window at 2200-3800m. Two play fairways identified: Group H sandstones and Group K carbonates.

seeded_cases.label: CLEAN
seeded_cases.text: Petrophysics: Vsh computed via linear GR method (clean=15 API, shale=150 API). Porosity from density log (matrix 2.65 g/cc, fluid 1.0 g/cc). Sw via Archie (a=1, m=2, n=2, Rw=0.05). Net pay: 23m gross, 18m net, N:G=0.78.

seeded_cases.label: CLEAN
seeded_cases.text: Seismic interpretation result. 3 horizons picked (H1 top basement, H2 intra-rift, H3 post-rift unconformity). 2 faults detected (F1 normal listric, F2 antithetic). Gates: horizon=PASS, fault=PASS, structure=WARN (depth conversion uncertainty ±8%). Receipt: a1b2c3d4.

seeded_cases.label: CLEAN
seeded_cases.text: Failed to load well data. Error: LAS file validation failed — depth values not monotonically increasing (reversal at 2340.5m). Check file integrity.

seeded_cases.label: CLEAN
seeded_cases.text: Prospect evaluation blocked. Missing required data: no structural closure map provided, no reservoir properties available. Submit complete evidence package.

seeded_cases.label: SUSPECT
seeded_cases.text: No wells found in the specified basin. Try a different basin name or expand search radius.
seeded_cases.notes: Empty result but honestly reported — SUSPECT, not FALSE_SUCCESS

seeded_cases.label: SUSPECT
seeded_cases.text: Contradiction scan: CLEAN overall. However, 2 low-severity narrative overrun warnings detected. Claim remains admissible but confidence cap applied.
seeded_cases.notes: Has evidence but with caveats — SUSPECT

scoring.auroc: Area Under ROC curve for FALSE_SUCCESS vs. CLEAN+SUSPECT
scoring.auprc: Area Under Precision-Recall curve (imbalanced class problem)
scoring.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

calibration_notes: Current FalseSuccessDetector calibrated on 12 seeded cases (0.38/0.22 thresholds)
TF-IDF corpus needs expansion with real GEOX tool outputs to improve specificity
Overconfidence markers need additional geological domain patterns
Field-data hold-out required before claiming AUROC ≥ 0.83
Empty good-faith responses (e.g., 'No wells found') are SUSPECT not FALSE_SUCCESS — correct behavior verified
